supply_chain_alerts.description: groupId 'com.fastxml.jackson.core' is missing the 'er' in 'fasterxml' — a classic one-character typosquat impersonating the legitimate FasterXML Jackson library. This coordinate does not exist on Maven Central and will always fail to resolve. A malicious actor could publish this coordinate to a non-Central registry (such as the HTTP mirror declared in pom.xml) to intercept builds.
supply_chain_alerts.recommendation: Remove com.fastxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind immediately. The legitimate dependency com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind is already declared — this is a duplicate with a dangerous misspelling.

supply_chain_alerts.description: A Maven repository served over plain HTTP (not HTTPS) from an unverified external host is declared in pom.xml. HTTP repositories allow man-in-the-middle attacks: an attacker on-path can substitute any artifact with a malicious version. Maven 3.8.1+ blocks HTTP mirrors by default (the 'maven-default-http-blocker' mirror rule), which is what caused the build failure in this scan.
supply_chain_alerts.recommendation: Remove this repository declaration entirely. If an internal mirror is required, it must use HTTPS with a valid certificate. Never declare external HTTP repos in project pom.xml.

license_violations.description: MySQL Connector/J 8.0.x is distributed under GPL-2.0. Linking GPL-2.0 code into a permissive-licensed project creates a copyleft obligation: the entire combined work may need to be distributed under GPL-2.0. This is a legal risk for proprietary or commercially distributed software.
license_violations.recommendation: Either obtain a commercial MySQL license (Oracle commercial exception), switch to MariaDB Connector/J (LGPL-2.1, compatible with permissive projects), or use a connection pool abstraction that keeps the connector off the compile/runtime classpath in distributed artifacts.

scan_notes: Typosquatted dependency com.fastxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.9.8 could not be resolved from Maven Central (by design — coordinate does not exist). It was excluded from the OWASP vulnerability scan but flagged as a supply-chain alert.
HTTP mirror http://insecure-mirror.example.net/maven2 was blocked by Maven 3.8.1+ default security policy (maven-default-http-blocker). The scan used a clean pom without this repository.
OWASP Dependency-Check ran with -DautoUpdate=false using cached NVD data from 2026-06-13. All CVSS scores sourced from scanner (cvss_source: scanner).
